oil.when: 2009–2011 with the message center SETUP and RESET buttons
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
With the ignition on, press and release SETUP until the message center shows OIL LIFE with the current percentage and HOLD RESET = NEW.
Press and hold RESET for about two seconds, then let go. Oil life goes back to 100%.
Only if you want a shorter interval: when OIL LIFE SET TO shows, press RESET again; each press lowers the starting value by 10%.
oil.note: Checked in the 2009 and 2011 Flex owner's guides.
